headline: WEG Acquires Land in India for R$44 Million to Expand Operations
summary: WEG purchased a 400,000-square-meter plot of land in India for R$44 million. The new site is located 95 kilometers from its Hosur manufacturing park.
why: Geographic expansion allows industrial manufacturers to scale production capacity and strengthen supply chain resilience in growing international markets.

impacts.name: WEG
impacts.why: The land acquisition supports the expansion of the company's international operational footprint.
